Kento Alpha 0.9.46, build 3173

New

  • Kiri matches the plate's grain: turn on match the plate's grain (Balance) and the background's grain is put on the foreground, inside its matte, at the foreground's brightness, so a clean subject sits in a grainy plate. Key from the degrained copy for it, so the foreground's own grain comes out first.
  • Kiri draws its edge band: change the band's width and the band shows over the picture in yellow for a moment, round the matte's edge, with its width named and the place you picked the screen ringed. Pick screen now remembers where it sampled.
  • FilmLab has halation and grain, as Asobi's Film Lab does: a halation box with strength, size, threshold, hue, bounce and scatter, working on the scene light before the look, and a grain box with amount, color and seed. A look's settings keep its halation.
  • FilmLab's negative and print menus show headings: motion picture, still, black-and-white and reversal negatives; motion picture prints, photographic paper, black-and-white and reversal prints.

Changed

  • The Color menu is in submenus: Grade and correct, Looks and film, Color spaces, OCIO, Math and 3D LUT. The toolbar's Grade button is gone: ReviewGrade, CDLLook, Look and FilmLab are under Color > Looks and film. A favourite whose node moved is still found.
  • The Lens node asks before a model change it can't fit closely: it says how far off the closest fit would be and why (NukeX Classic's anamorphic terms, for one), with Change anyway (one undo) or keep the model you had. It had switched back without a word.
  • While the Assistant answers, it says how long it's been, with a Stop button in words beside it.
  • A clone's time offset in a Nuke script renders as NukeX renders it: it works when the clone's source is a background input and does nothing on the foreground, as in NukeX. Clones painted in Kento keep their time offset on any source.
  • Renders use memory better: deep pictures (ScanlineRender's cards) and the 4K planes a comp keeps asking for are reused from frame to frame instead of taken fresh each time.

Fixed

  • The Assistant through Claude Code no longer hangs when it adds nodes: its Apply and Skip card failed to appear, and the reply waited for ever.
  • Settings > AI and MCP: the assistant menu takes another app; it had stayed on the first.
  • A pane's Split Vertical and Split Horizontal give two even halves; the new pane had come out a sliver, squeezing the panels beside it. The pane menu says Close Pane (it showed "emove Panel").
  • The icons in a pane's corner stay put: hovering over them brought back blank squares. The editor focus button shows what the pane follows (the selection, the Focus Node, a bookmark, or pinned).

Kento Alpha 0.9.45, build 3163

Fixed

  • The Assistant through an app you're signed into (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex) reaches Kento again: it had said "Connection closed", because the app was started with Kento's own Python settings and Kento's tools couldn't start under them. Other apps' MCP servers start cleanly too.
  • The Assistant panel no longer widens past its dock: the status line beside the model shortens with "..." (the whole line in its tooltip) and your messages narrow with the panel, so nothing is cut off on the right.
  • Settings > AI and MCP, with an app you're signed into: the model row says it's the app's own, and the MLX LM license line shows only for This Mac.

Kento Alpha 0.9.44, build 3156

New

  • Kento's assistant runs on this Mac by itself: Settings > AI and MCP > Kento's assistant > Install... downloads Apple's MLX LM (about 130 MB, into Kento's ML folder), and Kento starts it when the Assistant panel opens (Start and Stop beside it). The model menu lists the models on this Mac with their sizes; Download a model... lists Hugging Face's MLX models as they are today, with each one's size and license page before anything is downloaded. The context row sets how much of the conversation the model is given.
  • Codex joins Claude Code and Gemini CLI as an app you're signed into: the assistant runs through it with no API key.
  • Settings > General > New nodes: the bbox a new Merge starts with (union as Nuke, B, or by operation), so a studio needs no startup script for it.
  • Settings > Scripting offers the studio's own plugin folders (a folder in the studio's _LIBRARY/gizmos with an init.py or menu.py) under the startup scripts, with Add. Kento never adds one unasked.
  • New frames come quicker from a network share: while you look at a frame, Kento reads the next frames' files from the NAS (only what the Viewer shows, a Retime's frames included). On a heavy 4K comp read from the NAS, a new frame went from 1.31 s to 0.95 s scrubbing forward.

Changed

  • A Merge can set its own bbox: turn on auto bbox (under bbox) and it takes A's box for mask and in, and the plate's for over, stencil, out and the rest. A Nuke script saves the box it chose.
  • Kiri's Match to background now says it's a starting point to judge by eye: on test renders a full match often landed further off than none.
  • Kiri's panel reads better for a compositor: the clean plate's choices say None when nothing is connected, the edge model's progress is a line under the model rather than a second "model" row, amount and pixel fields carry their words, screen match sits under the screen, the sections carry their board's notes, and controls not in Kento yet say so.
  • Kiri says when the screen clips and no clean plate is connected: a burnt-out screen keys worst without one, so the clean plate row suggests making one with CleanPlate.

Fixed

  • As Kento opens, the Viewer shows the picture centered and filling the view, whatever the screen size, and fits it again while the window settles; it had opened small and off center.
  • LensDistortion2 now renders R-T Coupled, Radial Asymmetric at order 4, the beam splitter's bending and the tangential terms' denominators as Nuke does: they had been up to 419 pixels off.
  • Paint: a stroke picked in History stays picked when another Paint's panel is open, and undoing a picked stroke away stops editing it.
